reviews.title: Geat cooler
reviews.comment: This thing is amazing. Got thr fan lights to sync up with my other fan lights using the motherboard sync function with no issue. All I did was plug it in. The screen is actually really cool. Again, plug and play. You do have to use the software to get it to show things. It plays video which is really cool. I just uploaded a video and then it was showing up on the screen. Others said the software was weird. It's fine, it did have a learning curve for me, but ultimately when you figure it out, it is super easy. I didn't want overlays over my video so you just have to turn off everything you can in the edit menu and that's it, I got what I wanted, just the video with no overlay. Well worth it and this thing keeps my cpu cool so that's awesome too. No overheating at all. Great cooler. I recommend.
reviews.author: Adriel Romo

reviews.title: Works fantastic
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/C1YCSDxrycL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/61fbRe1jSPL._SY256.jpg It's wonderful currently. If anything with it becomes in issue within a certain time I'll update. It looks beautiful. The build quality seems great, it came with the fans pre installed, only had to daisy chain them. Definitely good value for your money. It came with some thermal paste that was very thick and hard to smear rated for like 14w/mk and people said it'd need to be spread out with a spatula or card as it won't smoosh evenly with the line or bead method. I just put on some 7w/mk thermal paste as it's rated good enough for what I need and by far easier to spread.
Only complaint I have is their website for the software was buggy. It wouldn't get past the verifying human page on any of the browsers I have. Went to the website on my phone and downloaded the software, transferred it to the pc and it worked.
I'll straighten the type c cable for it later, as I'm still waiting on my reverse fans to install and do my cable management lol.

reviews.title: Solid Cooler. The Software could use some work however…
reviews.comment: Only complaints are the radiator hums a bit, and that the software could definitely use some work. The screen for my LCD creen randomly turns off and on due to it conflicting with other software running in the background for my pc. Other than that, the performance is insane for the price. My Ryzen 5 5600x never goes past 70c even at the highest settings and the aesthetics are spectacular. Solid product overall.
